boundaries: The current real OpenAI receipt covers seven synthetic browser/worker requests; the retained five-request receipt is historical. Neither establishes hiring accuracy or fairness.
No real institutional SSO, private candidate processing, payroll, external email, hosted deployment or physical-device validation.
Uploaded PDF/TXT bytes are not parsed by AI; supplied qualification fields, answers and typed background text are analyzed.
Finite tests and source review do not establish hiring quality, perfect de-identification, production scale or universal accessibility.
